message.reasoning_content: We need to classify relationship between two statements. Both are from same actor (blinded). Need to see if they address same specific proposition. Manifestation B: about data protection, ANPD, data leaks, need for strengthening agency, protecting citizen data. Different topics. Both have determinable positions (support for blockchain innovation; support for data protection). But they are not same proposition. So INCOMPARABLE. Provide reasoning.
